### Files

- [adair-2012-reovirus-carriage.md](adair-2012-reovirus-carriage.md) — Adair et al. 2012 — human proof that intravenous reovirus hitchhikes on blood cells to reach tumor despite pre-existing neutralizing antibodies
- [an-2024-pe-evlp.md](an-2024-pe-evlp.md) — An et al. 2024 — prime-editor virus-like particles (PE-eVLP) deliver prime editors transiently in vivo, extending RNP-VLP delivery to the largest editor class that exceeds single-AAV capacity
- [andtbacka-2019-tvec-optim.md](andtbacka-2019-tvec-optim.md) — Andtbacka et al. (OPTiM) — T-VEC, the first FDA/EMA-approved oncolytic virus, in a randomized phase 3 versus GM-CSF in melanoma, with quantified abscopal lesion-level responses
- [andtbacka-2021-calm-cva21.md](andtbacka-2021-calm-cva21.md) — Andtbacka et al. 2021 (CALM) — intratumoral coxsackievirus A21 (CVA21) monotherapy in melanoma, the local-route half of the route-dependence contrast with the failed IV STORM/CLEVER trials
- [banskota-2022-evlp.md](banskota-2022-evlp.md) — Banskota & Liu 2022 — fourth-generation engineered virus-like particles deliver base-editor RNP in vivo (63% liver editing, PCSK9 −78%) with off-target near-eliminated versus DNA vectors
- [block-2025-tilt123-prota.md](block-2025-tilt123-prota.md) — Block et al. 2025 (PROTA) — TILT-123, an IL-2/TNFα-armed oncolytic adenovirus, plus pembrolizumab in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, phase 1a
- [demircan-2024-dart-aav.md](demircan-2024-dart-aav.md) — Demircan et al. 2024 — DART-AAV, a DARPin-displayed CD8-retargeted AAV, transduces up to 80% of activated CD8 T cells in vivo with near-absolute selectivity and liver de-targeting
- [desjardins-2018-pvsripo.md](desjardins-2018-pvsripo.md) — Desjardins et al. 2018 — PVSRIPO (poliovirus:rhinovirus chimera) in recurrent glioblastoma produces a durable ~21% long-survivor plateau rather than a whole-curve shift
- [doronin-2009-peg-adenovirus.md](doronin-2009-peg-adenovirus.md) — Doronin et al. 2009 — high-molecular-weight (20 kDa) PEGylation reduces oncolytic adenovirus liver transduction 57–90-fold and improves intravenous efficacy
- [downs-canner-2016-vvdd-iv.md](downs-canner-2016-vvdd-iv.md) — Downs-Canner et al. 2016 — intravenous double-deleted vaccinia (vvDD) reaches only 2 of 8 tumor biopsies and is rapidly cleared, the clearest clinical delivery-barrier document
- [eid-2024-fit4function.md](eid-2024-fit4function.md) — Eid et al. 2024 — Fit4Function machine-learning AAV capsid engineering co-optimizes multiple clinical traits and predicts cross-species (macaque) biodistribution from mouse plus human-in-vitro data
- [evgin-2015-complement.md](evgin-2015-complement.md) — Evgin et al. 2015 — complement, not antibody, is the dominant inactivator of oncolytic vaccinia in immune humans and macaques, and complement inhibition rescues delivery
- [fares-2021-nsc-glioma.md](fares-2021-nsc-glioma.md) — Fares et al. 2021 — neural stem cells delivering an oncolytic adenovirus into the glioma resection cavity, first-in-human, median OS 18.4 months
- [freedman-2017-enad-epcam-bite.md](freedman-2017-enad-epcam-bite.md) — Freedman et al. 2017 — enadenotucirev encoding an EpCAM-BiTE secretes a T-cell engager that activates endogenous T cells and kills targets in primary patient ascites despite immunosuppression
- [friedman-2021-g207.md](friedman-2021-g207.md) — Friedman et al. 2021 — G207 oncolytic HSV in pediatric high-grade glioma roughly doubles median survival and converts immunologically quiet tumors to T-cell-infiltrated
- [garcia-carbonero-2017-enad-iv.md](garcia-carbonero-2017-enad-iv.md) — Garcia-Carbonero et al. 2017 — enadenotucirev is the first oncolytic virus with clearly demonstrated consistent tumor delivery after intravenous administration (11/12 biopsies positive)
- [ilett-berkeley-2018-nab-neutralized.md](ilett-berkeley-2018-nab-neutralized.md) — Ilett/Berkeley et al. 2018 — antibody-neutralized reovirus remains effective because monocytes internalize the virus–antibody complex via Fc receptors and deliver replicative virus to tumor
- [kennedy-2022-synthetic-rna-virus.md](kennedy-2022-synthetic-rna-virus.md) — Kennedy et al. 2022 — LNP-delivered synthetic Seneca Valley virus RNA sidesteps capsid-directed neutralizing antibodies entirely, enabling true repeat intravenous dosing
- [khare-2011-kupffer-sequestration.md](khare-2011-kupffer-sequestration.md) — Khare et al. 2011 — up to 90% of an intravenous adenovirus dose is scavenged by liver Kupffer cells, governed by hexon HVR charge and Factor X binding
- [kim-2014-rnp-offtarget.md](kim-2014-rnp-offtarget.md) — Kim et al. 2014 — Cas9 delivered as purified ribonucleoprotein is 9.5–13× more specific than plasmid-encoded Cas9, the origin datum for transient-delivery-lowers-off-target
- [kowalsky-2018-vvdd-il15.md](kowalsky-2018-vvdd-il15.md) — Kowalsky et al. 2018 — IL-15 superagonist-armed oncolytic vaccinia cures 80% of tumors vs 0% for the unarmed backbone, entirely CD8-dependent, synergizing with anti-PD-1
- [mader-2009-msc-measles.md](mader-2009-msc-measles.md) — Mader et al. 2009 — mesenchymal stem cell carriers protect oncolytic measles from antibody neutralization and double survival in immune mice, the definitive naked-vs-carrier experiment
- [michels-2023-vivovec-poc.md](michels-2023-vivovec-poc.md) — Michels et al. 2023 — VivoVec UB-VV100 preclinical proof of concept for in-vivo CAR-T from unstimulated PBMCs with a rapamycin-gated expansion switch
- [moehler-2019-traverse-iv.md](moehler-2019-traverse-iv.md) — Moehler et al. 2019 (TRAVERSE) — intravenous oncolytic vaccinia pexa-vec added no survival benefit in second-line HCC, blunted by anti-vaccinia neutralizing antibodies
- [montagna-2018-vesicas.md](montagna-2018-vesicas.md) — Montagna et al. 2018 (VEsiCas) — VSV-G-enveloped vesicles deliver Cas9 RNP genome-wide with 87 off-target sites collapsing to a single site versus plasmid
- [nicolai-2024-vivovec-nhp.md](nicolai-2024-vivovec-nhp.md) — Nicolai et al. 2024 — VivoVec targeted lentivirus generates CAR-T in nonhuman primates without lymphodepletion, up to 65% circulating CAR-T and durable B-cell aplasia
- [olarewaju-2024-fap-aav.md](olarewaju-2024-fap-aav.md) — Olarewaju et al. 2024 — an αFAP-nanobody-retargeted AAV2 redirects delivery to the tumor stroma with simultaneous liver and spleen de-targeting
- [roulstone-2021-nab-kinetics.md](roulstone-2021-nab-kinetics.md) — Roulstone et al. 2021 — kinetics of the neutralizing antibody response to intravenous oncolytic reovirus (onset day 5–8, peak day 15, IgG1-dominant, gemcitabine-attenuated)
- [tanoue-2017-cadvec-minibody.md](tanoue-2017-cadvec-minibody.md) — Tanoue et al. 2017 — an oncolytic adenovirus secreting an anti-PD-L1 minibody keeps the antibody in tumor and undetectable in serum, outperforming systemic checkpoint antibody
- [todo-2022-g47delta.md](todo-2022-g47delta.md) — Todo et al. 2022 — G47Δ (teserpaturev/DELYTACT), the triple-mutated oncolytic HSV-1 that is the only virus approved for a primary brain cancer, phase 2 glioblastoma
- [wong-2025-rp1-ignyte.md](wong-2025-rp1-ignyte.md) — Wong et al. 2025 (IGNYTE) — RP1 (fusogenic GM-CSF-armed oncolytic HSV-1) plus nivolumab in anti-PD-1-failed melanoma, strong single-arm efficacy but an FDA Complete Response Letter
- [yu-2014-ephA2-tea-vv.md](yu-2014-ephA2-tea-vv.md) — Yu et al. 2014 — EphA2 T-cell-engager-armed oncolytic vaccinia (EphA2-TEA-VV) gives 100% complete remission vs none for the unarmed virus, the cleanest in-vivo BiTE-arming survival delta
